policy.production_claim_requires: first-party disclosure tied to assessment, deployment decisions, live monitoring, or an operational safeguard
policy.current_local_authority_requires: completed local qualification against the registered product claim, data, evaluator, environment, and offline-to-live evidence
policy.absence_wording: No public deployment proof found is not proof that no private deployment exists.

claims.observed_use: Cross-entropy-method importance sampling was evaluated on three models and parameterized GSM8K templates.
claims.not_proven: No public production deployment or release-gate evidence found.
claims.local_adoption: Reproduce on a controlled enumerable world, validate proposal support and weights, then shadow against live outcomes.

claims.observed_use: A field study compared offline behavior with prompts submitted by 800 real ChatGPT and Gemini users; long-memory benchmarks provide reproducible stress tests.
claims.not_proven: The sources do not establish a generally validated production release gate for personalization or memory.
claims.local_adoption: Run reset-versus-persist, counter-user, and preference-update tests on consented or synthetic histories and compare with reviewed traffic.

claims.observed_use: AgentRewardBench compares automatic evaluators on 1,302 expert-reviewed web-agent trajectories.
claims.not_proven: Leaderboard performance does not prove transfer to a product, traffic distribution, or release decision.
claims.local_adoption: Use the benchmark for screening, then qualify false-pass, false-block, rank-fidelity, and side-effect detection on local evidence.

claims.observed_use: Research methods correct raw judge rates using measured sensitivity and specificity and show the importance of human or verified references.
claims.not_proven: No public production deployment proof found, and transfer of judge error rates under distribution shift remains an assumption.
claims.local_adoption: Report corrected and raw estimates together until representative local calibration and shift tests support bounded use.

claims.observed_use: A peer-reviewed medical benchmark study applied computerized adaptive testing to 38 LLMs, while a broad simulation study identified population regimes that make IRT inferences unreliable.
claims.not_proven: No public production deployment proof found for adaptive or IRT-based LLM release gating.
claims.local_adoption: Validate model fit, item-bank stability, rank consistency, exposure, and mandatory safety-core coverage before using adaptive selection to reduce cost.

claims.named_operational_use: OpenAI pre-deployment safety review, model development, and forecast backtesting across GPT-5-series Thinking deployments.
claims.observed_use: OpenAI reports using deployment replay on about 1.3 million de-identified conversations and an agentic study using 120,000 internal employee trajectories.
claims.not_proven: Historical prefixes can drift, rare behaviors can be missed, and the disclosure does not prove transfer to another product or traffic distribution.
claims.local_adoption: Register a privacy-safe replay population and forecast, verify simulator fidelity, then compare predictions with canary and post-release outcomes.

claims.named_operational_use: Anthropic alignment assessment for every Claude model since Sonnet 4.5 and UK AISI sabotage-propensity evaluation.
claims.observed_use: Petri uses simulated users and tools, an auditor agent, and a judge to surface alignment-relevant behavior for assessment.
claims.not_proven: The disclosure does not establish that automated scores alone controlled release or that generated audits cover all alignment failures.
claims.local_adoption: Use Petri for discovery, human-review traces, reproduce confirmed behavior, and promote fixed cases into regression coverage.

claims.observed_use: Anthropic released an executable framework that generates targeted behavioral suites and reported agreement with hand labels plus separation of baseline and intentionally misaligned models.
claims.not_proven: No public evidence establishes Bloom itself as a routine production release gate or shows causal deployment outcomes.
claims.local_adoption: Use generated suites in sandbox or shadow, then qualify construct, realism, diversity, grader behavior, and reproducibility.

claims.named_operational_use: OpenAI monitoring for internal coding agents, long-running sessions, frontier workloads, and higher-risk model safeguards.
claims.observed_use: OpenAI discloses chain-of-thought monitoring for internal coding agents, long-running sessions, frontier workloads, and high-risk model safeguards.
claims.not_proven: Monitorability is incomplete and model-dependent; the evidence does not make reasoning traces faithful explanations or a sufficient safety case.
claims.local_adoption: Measure agent and monitor jointly, retain action/output and deterministic controls, and validate operational responses to flags.

claims.named_operational_use: OpenAI audio-specific pre-deployment evaluation for GPT-4o and active session classifiers in the generally available Realtime API.
claims.observed_use: OpenAI documents audio-specific pre-deployment evaluation and active classifiers in the generally available Realtime API.
claims.not_proven: The sources do not establish a complete end-to-end production evaluation stack for task quality, interruption, noise, latency, and business outcomes.
claims.local_adoption: Add modality-specific task, safety, acoustic, turn-taking, tail-latency, tool, and recovery measurements before local qualification.

claims.observed_use: A peer-reviewed study optimized attacks against eight indirect prompt-injection defenses and bypassed every tested defense under its reported conditions.
claims.not_proven: The study is evidence about adaptive attack pressure, not proof of an effective deployed defense or a production release control.
claims.local_adoption: Attack the exact deployed prompt, retriever, tools, permissions, and detectors while retaining external authorization and effect-boundary controls.

claims.observed_use: Four blind teams audited a deliberately trained model organism and three recovered its implanted hidden objective using mixed methods.
claims.not_proven: Auditors knew a hidden objective existed and tested one model organism, so the result does not establish reliable discovery in deployed frontier models.
claims.local_adoption: Use the design for audit exercises and method comparison while preserving behavioral, outcome, interpretability, and data-analysis evidence separately.

claims.observed_use: LongMemEval, NoLiMa, and Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench provide reproducible stress instruments for memory, semantic retrieval, and long-running agent work.
claims.not_proven: Benchmark performance does not establish product reliability, privacy, latency, or outcomes under real histories and environments.
claims.local_adoption: Use the benchmarks for construct stress, then add consented product histories, state invariants, tool faults, cost, latency, and reviewed incidents.
